## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: weak breadth (4/11) and narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology)); major divergence across large-cap names (multiple 1W vs 1M sign flips) reinforces caution.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND. Communication showing selective strength: META (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +7.23%) ABOVE TREND. Financials mixed but with pockets of strength: CME (1W: +3.93% | 1M: +6.95%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Discretionary lagging: TSLA (1W: -3.89% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION, RCL (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -13.21%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare showing weakness and dispersion: LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY. Industrials soft: CAT (1W: -3.34% | 1M: -1.10%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +17.22%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +5.89% | 1M: +17.60%) ABOVE TREND; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND, EOG (1W: -6.34% | 1M: -1.48%) BELOW TREND, LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, ROST (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -9.51%) BELOW TREND; weakness concentrated in select high-volatility names and payments.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Strongest 1W movers: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND, SLB (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +17.22%) ABOVE TREND; notable divergences include AAPL (1W: +3.35% | 1M: -4.04%) RECOVERY and TSLA (1W: -3.89% | 1M: +12.92%) CORRECTION — watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Tech shows concentrated leadership with mixed internals: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.32% | 1M: +11.54%) ABOVE TREND; Sector breadth: Technology is among the 4/11 sectors positive, implying internal rotation despite big winners.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials are patchy but with pockets of resilience: CME (1W: +3.93% | 1M: +6.95%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +1.93%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.85% | 1M: +4.38%) ABOVE TREND; sector is one of the 4 positive sectors but breadth remains shallow.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare is showing dispersion and tactical weakness: LLY (1W: -6.44% | 1M: +1.85%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +5.29%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +0.73% | 1M: -6.77%) RECOVERY; sector overall is negative on 1W and vulnerable to headline risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective Technology and Financials leaders (CRM, MSFT, CME) while reducing exposure to structurally weak Consumer Disc and isolated laggards like PYPL and AMAT; Style: Growth tilt but mixed due to narrow leadership and weak breadth. Monitor major divergence — treat rallies as tactical until internals broaden.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +12.63% | 1M: +31.47%) ABOVE TREND for momentum follow-through. BEARISH: PYPL (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND on earnings/news sensitivity.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology and Communication if leadership broadens beyond the top handful (breadth needs to expand beyond current narrow base). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary and Healthcare given recent 1W weakness and headline risk.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
CRM: monitor for continuation above recent breakout (ABOVE TREND) to signal further momentum; MSFT: support near recent pullback levels — hold ABOVE TREND status to confirm participation; PYPL: a weekly close below recent support would extend BELOW TREND pressure and increase downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
BA (+65): Boeing (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND — bullish defense order headlines but price below trend = divergence to watch. AMAT (+65): Applied Materials (1W: -6.23% | 1M: -7.89%) BELOW TREND — positive AI buildout headlines but price remains below trend, watch for confirmation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
PYPL (-55): PayPal (1W: -12.82% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND — bearish headlines confirmed by sharp price weakness. BA (-55): Boeing (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -5.02%) BELOW TREND — mixed headlines; sentiment and price both show risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Growth tilt. CRM (1W: +22.39% | 1M: +41.66%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +14.05%) ABOVE TREND, CME (1W: +3.93% | 1M: +6.95%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow leadership (4/5 Tech), weak breadth (4/11) and major 1W/1M divergences (PYPL, AMAT, AAPL/TSLA patterns) — monitor for trend break or broader confirmation.
